page_title: WER 1-1 MON | Werder Bremen v B. Monchengladbach 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

90+4' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Moritz Nicolas, so the score changes to 1:1.
90+3' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) takes the corner.
90+3' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Werder Bremen get a corner.
90+1' A pass into the box finds Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Mio Backhaus denies him.
90+1' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Mbangula trots off the pitch and is replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
88' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

88' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the top right corner. However, Moritz Nicolas anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The ball goes out for a corner. Werder Bremen can continue in their attacking effort.
84' Problems for Eugen Polanski as Joe Scally is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) replaces him.
84' Eugen Polanski has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Haris Tabakovic.
84' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance!
84' A tremendous drive by Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Moritz Nicolas makes a brilliant save.
83' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:6.

81' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

80' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.

80' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
78' Werder Bremen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
77' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
76' The attendance for today's match is 41800.
75' It is time for a substitution. Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) is on for Julian Malatini.
75' Looks like Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
73' Werder Bremen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

72' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
69' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Marvin Friedrich.
67' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
64' Horst Steffen decides to make a substitution. Justin Njinmah will be replaced by Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen).
64' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yukinari Sugawara.
64' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
63' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) picks up an injury.
61' 0 - 1 Goal! Franck Honorat tees up Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.

51' B. Monchengladbach enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
49' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.

49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

48' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Moritz Nicolas sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
44' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
42' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

38' Some patient build-up play from B. Monchengladbach as they look to unlock the defence.
34' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
32' Flag up against Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
31' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
30' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
29' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
28' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
27' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
27' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) jumps into a tackle and Felix Zwayer signals a foul. Werder Bremen are awarded a free kick.
27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
25' The ball is cleared after Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
24' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
20' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and B. Monchengladbach manage to earn a corner.
19' The fouls committed statistics – 4:5.
15' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
15' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Werder Bremen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

14' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
14' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

13' A cross from Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' 58:42 – the latest ball possession ratio.
8' B. Monchengladbach control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

5' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and signals a foul after Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) brought his opponent down. Werder Bremen win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

4' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) blazes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
1' B. Monchengladbach keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
